Depends on the Ice Islands Quest and collecting shards

The {wiki:Norseman Outfits|Norseman Outfit} protects you from the endless winter of {wiki:Hrodmir|Hrodmir}. You get the outfit by completing {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} and the addons by handing frostheart shards ({item:Shard|Shards}) to the shaman {npc:Hjaern}, in Svargrond: 5 shards for the Spear and 10 more for the Hood/Earmuffs. You also get the achievement **Out in the Snowstorm**.
Cold in this endless Hrodmir winter? Maybe this outfit will suit you.

After handing in 15 shards in total.
The dangers of this quest are the creatures of the ice island {wiki:Hrodmir|Hrodmir}, the cultists and, possibly, many demonic creatures.
The base Norseman Outfit is earned by completing {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}.

In **Svargrond** (boat from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore**: say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, on the **east** side of the city), go to the ice area **north** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the dog sled owner: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of {wiki:Nibelor} (only after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}). The shaman {npc:Hjaern} is in a cave in the **north** of the island.

Gather 5 {item:Shard|Shards} and go to {npc:Hjaern}, on the island of **Nibelor**, near Svargrond. Say {key:hi}, {key:frostheart shard} and {key:yes}. Once you have handed in 5 shards, he gives you the addon.

Gather 10 more {item:Shard|Shards} and go back to {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:frostheart shard} and {key:yes}. Once you have handed in **15 shards in total**, you receive the second addon (you can ask him about {key:reward} to see if you have enough yet).
From here on, every extra shard you hand in to Hjaern is worth 2000 gold.

To return to Svargrond, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the Nibelor stone circle, and ask for {key:passage}. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
You now have the Norseman Outfit with both addons.
This quest also gives the achievement **Out in the Snowstorm**.
